askpage.bulunan-alintilar-soruyu-tam-kar: The excerpts found do not fully answer the question. Try different words, or loosen the filters.
askpage.kayitlar-taraniyor-ve-okunuyor-y: Reading through the recordings. On a local model this can take a minute.
askpage.konusulanlara-dair-bir-soru-sor-: Ask a question about what was said. The answer is built only from your own recordings, with the excerpts it rests on underneath — you are not asked to believe it unread.
askpage.ornek-ahmet-le-fiyat-konusunda-n: For example: what was said about the price with Ahmet?
contactspage.bir-gorusme-kaydedilip-kime: A call appears here once it has been recorded and you have said who it was with.
contactspage.bu-gorusmeyi-bastan-yaziya-: Transcribe and analyse this call again from scratch. The audio is already on disk.
contactspage.bu-kisinin-gorusmelerini-ob: Write this person's calls into the Obsidian vault.
contactspage.bu-kisinin-verdigi-ve-hala-: No promise from this person is still outstanding.
contactspage.bu-kisiye-ait-her-seyi-kali: Permanently delete everything belonging to this person.
contactspage.bu-kisiyle-konusulanlarda-a: Search what was said with this person
contactspage.bu-kisiyle-olan-gorusmelerd: No unkept promise, changed figure or unanswered question was found in your calls with this person.
contactspage.soldaki-listeden-birini-sec: Choose somebody on the left and every call with them, the promises made, and anything worth noticing will appear here.
contactspage.tum-gorusme-sen-karsi-taraf: Switch between the whole conversation, you, and the other party
healthpage.bir-kaydedici-basariya-benzey: A recorder fails in ways that look like success: the wrong device records silence, a graphics card is visible but unusable, a service runs out of credit, a disk fills up. Every one of those is asked here out loud.
healthpage.bir-sey-ters-gittiginde-son-u: When something goes wrong you can copy the last three days of log and send it. It contains no conversation text, no contact names and no API keys — only what was done when, and what failed.
healthpage.bu-makinenin-ne-kadar-hizli-o: How fast this machine is cannot be read off its specification: the same card behaves differently with an old driver or when another application is holding memory. The measurement transcribes real audio and times it.
healthpage.bu-sayfanin-ekran-goruntusu-y: A screenshot of this page contains everything anybody would ask for.
healthpage.butun-gorusmeler-duz-markdown: Every call as plain markdown, one page per person. Readable without this application.
healthpage.hazirlanir-ve-uygulama-yenide: Staged, and put in place when the application restarts. Your current data is not deleted but set aside — restoring the wrong file must not destroy the archive you were trying to protect.
healthpage.kisa-bir-ornek-yaziya-dokulur: A short sample is transcribed and the real-time factor measured. If the model is not downloaded yet, this step fetches it.
healthpage.veritabani-ve-ayarlar-tek-dos: The database and settings in one file. Recordings dominate the size, so they are left out by default — the transcripts, the ledger and the settings are still backed up in full.
labelcallwindow.bu-pencere-basligini-bu-: Remember this window title for this person
ledgerpage.gorusmeyi-bu-andan-ac: Open the call at this moment
ledgerpage.tutulmamis-sozler-degisen-rak: Unkept promises, changed figures and unanswered questions — everybody in one place. Under every line are the words themselves; click the time, listen, decide for yourself.
overviewpage.alti-haftaya-yayilmis-uc-or: Three sample calls spread over six weeks: a price changes twice, a promise goes past its date, the same question is dodged twice. The ledger, the transcript and the share of talking all work exactly as they do on real data. One click removes them whenever you like.
overviewpage.bunlar-gercek-kayit-degil-k: These are not real recordings. Remove them whenever you like so they do not mix with your own calls.
overviewpage.ne-kaydedildi-ne-bekliyor-n: What was recorded, what is waiting, and what needs you.
overviewpage.soylenmis-ve-tarihi-gecmis-: Said, and past its date. The quote is the promise itself — the judgement is yours.
overviewpage.whatsapp-ya-da-telegram-uze: Recording starts by itself when you make a voice call on WhatsApp or Telegram. Before your first call it is worth testing audio capture under Status — a silent recording looks exactly like a successful one.
recordingoverlay.bu-gorusme-boyunca-seri: Hide the strip for this call — recording continues
searchpage.butun-gorusmelerin-metni-aran: Searches the text of every call. Turkish casing rules apply, so typing ışık also finds IŞIK. The start of a word is enough: searching kitap also finds kitabı.
searchpage.gorusmeyi-bu-andan-ac: Open the call at this moment
searchpage.kimin-ne-soyledigi-tahmin-deg: Who said what is not a guess: the two streams are recorded separately, so it is known.
searchpage.yalnizca-bu-kisiyle-olan-goru: Search only calls with this person
settingswindow.arayuzun-dili-konusulan-d: Only the language of the text on screen. The language spoken on your calls is unaffected — that is set under Transcription.
settingswindow.asagidaki-hata-oranlari-t: The error rates below are real measurements for Turkish. Lower is better; an empty cell means no measurement exists for that dataset.
settingswindow.baglantiyi-sinadiginda-li: Testing the connection fills this list with the models the provider actually serves. This is an extraction task, so it does not need a huge model; what matters is its Turkish.
settingswindow.bes-saniye-kayit-alip-iki: Records five seconds and tells you whether sound really arrived on both streams. Talk during the test and play some music at the same time.
settingswindow.bluetooth-kulakliklar-win: Bluetooth headsets appear to Windows twice: the hands-free version carries the microphone, drops to 16 kHz and takes the headphones out of stereo. The quality loss is obvious. Where you can, choose the computer's own microphone for input and the headset's stereo output for listening.
settingswindow.bu-modda-gorusme-kaydi-se: In this mode the recording is uploaded to the service you choose. Audio carries who was speaking, their tone, and the background.
settingswindow.bu-saglayici-bulutta-cali: This provider runs in the cloud: the text of the call is sent out. The audio is not.
settingswindow.bu-servise-yukleme-yapila: This service cannot be uploaded to
settingswindow.bulut-servisidir-ozetler-: A cloud service: summaries are sent to Notion's servers.
settingswindow.bulut-uzerinden-yaziya-do: Transcribing in the cloud needs at least one service. Start with Add a service above; define two and the second takes over when the first does not answer.
settingswindow.gorusme-basladiginda-hang: Which applications are recorded when a call starts, and how the audio is captured.
settingswindow.gorusme-bitince-otomatik-: Analyse automatically when a call ends
settingswindow.gorusme-bittikten-sonra-e: How long to wait after a call before using the graphics card. On a laptop the card shares its power budget with video calling, so this wait is what keeps the recorder from being noticed.
settingswindow.gorusme-ozetlerinin-uygul: Writing call summaries outside the application.
settingswindow.hoparlorle-konusurken-kar: On speakers the other party's voice also reaches the microphone and who said what becomes uncertain. Headphones still give the best result.
settingswindow.istek-bicimi-openai-ninki: Its request format differs from OpenAI's. It can be kept and its balance watched, but it is not used for transcription.
settingswindow.kapaliyken-aramalar-izlen: When off, calls are still watched but not recorded by themselves — you record by hand with "Start recording" whenever you want. It also toggles in one click from the notification area.
settingswindow.kapaliyken-kayit-ve-yaziy: When off, recording and transcription still work; only the ledger is not produced.
settingswindow.kapaliyken-yapilandirma-k: When off the configuration is kept but this service is not tried.
settingswindow.karsi-tarafi-duydugun-cih: The device you HEAR the other party on. If you listen with AirPods then AirPods must be selected here — the wrong device means the other party is never recorded, and nothing reports an error.
settingswindow.karsi-tarafin-sesi-nerede: Where the other party's voice is taken from
settingswindow.kayit-surerken-ekranin-us: While recording, a thin strip appears at the top of the screen showing the elapsed time, and it can be stopped from there. Leaving it on is recommended: with only a tray icon, a running recorder and a switched-off one look identical.
settingswindow.konusmanin-metne-cevrilme: Turning speech into text. It can run on this machine or be sent to a service.
settingswindow.konustugun-mikrofon-kulak: The microphone you speak into. If you listen on a headset but talk into the computer's microphone, choose the computer's microphone here.
settingswindow.kulakligi-yeni-taktiysan-: Refresh the list if you have just plugged in a headset
settingswindow.metinden-taahhutleri-degi: The layer that pulls promises, changed figures and unanswered questions out of the text. The model only finds and quotes; the comparisons are done by the application.
settingswindow.model-ilk-kullanimda-kend: The model downloads by itself on first use, but that keeps a call waiting. Fetch and test it here beforehand.
settingswindow.ollama-llama-server-ve-lm: Ollama, llama-server and LM Studio are probed on their usual ports.
settingswindow.otomatik-ekran-karti-eris: Automatic uses the graphics card when it can be reached.
settingswindow.senin-sesin-nereden-alins: Where your own voice is taken from
settingswindow.ses-opus-a-sikistirilip-g: Audio is compressed to Opus and, where needed, split at silent moments, so no word is cut in half. Each part is tried separately, a rate limit is waited out and retried, and finished parts are cached so a retry does not start from the beginning.
settingswindow.sifir-suresiz-saklamak-de: Zero means keep them forever. Pinned calls are not touched by this sweep.
settingswindow.sirayla-denenir-biri-ceva: Tried in order. If one does not answer or runs out of credit, the next takes over — there is only one copy of a recording and it must not be lost.
settingswindow.telegram-desktop-aramalar: Telegram Desktop calls. The contact's name is taken automatically from the call window's title.
settingswindow.toplam-sutunu-model-agirl: The total column is the model weights plus the context memory. On a 6 GB card Windows itself uses 0.5–1.2 GB, so in practice anything up to 4.65 GB runs comfortably.
settingswindow.vault-klasorune-markdown-: Writes markdown files into the vault folder. Entirely local; nothing leaves the machine.
settingswindow.whatsapp-desktop-uzerinde: Records voice calls made through WhatsApp Desktop.
settingswindow.yalnizca-whatsapp-ve-tele: Takes only WhatsApp and Telegram audio, so music playing in the background stays out of the recording. In exchange, this Windows interface reports no clock information and is known to produce silent recordings in some applications. With it off, all system audio is recorded, and that is more reliable.
settingswindow.yerelde-calistirmak-varsa: Running locally is the default and nothing leaves the machine. Sending to the cloud means sending the call's audio out — not just its text.
setupwindow.bu-adim-tamamlanamadi: This step could not be completed
setupwindow.hicbirini-kurmadan-da-kullan: You can use it without installing any of this
setupwindow.voicetranscript-whatsapp-ve-: VoiceTranscript records WhatsApp and Telegram calls and transcribes them into Turkish. It installs what it needs itself — you only have to wait.
setupwindow.yaziya-dokmeyi-bir-api-uzeri: If you transcribe through an API you need neither Python nor a model; an API key is enough. In exchange, the call's audio is uploaded to that service. Under Settings you can define several providers and put them in order: if one does not answer, the next takes over.
